gizmo.title: Raadinta erayada
gizmo.description: Shabakad xarfo ah oo leh erayo qarsoon. Ardaydu waxay taabtaan xarafka ugu horreeya iyo kan ugu dambeeya ee erey kasta. Waxay ku layliyaan aqoonsiga sida erey loo higgaadiyo, ma aha macnihiisa.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Waxa ardayda laga codsanayo inay helaan, oo ka muuqda madaxa.

configure.title: Erayada
configure.description: Erayada la qarinayo. Meelaha bannaan iyo calaamadaha waa laga reebaa shabakadda. Erayada aan ku habboonayn waa la taxaa inta aad wax beddelayso waana laga reebaa ardayda.

advanced.title: Cabbirka shabakadda
advanced.description: Xarfo dhinackiiba, 4 ilaa 16. Ka tag madhan si uu ugu habboonaado ereyga ugu dheer (ilaa 12). In ka badan 12 waxay dhinac u rogmataa taleefanka.

advanced.title: Erayo qalloocan
advanced.description: Sidoo kale erayada u qari si qalloocan. Ka adag.

advanced.title: Erayo gadaal ah
advanced.description: Sidoo kale qari erayo gadaal loo qoray. Ka adag.

advanced.title: Midabka xoojinta
advanced.description: Midab ikhtiyaari ah oo loogu talagalay chip-ka madaxa, xarafka koowaad ee la doortay iyo badhanka.
